name: EMCOR Group, Inc.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26, accession 0000105634-26-000025), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: 'Non-cash share-based compensation expense' $20,595 thousand for FY2025 and $19,978 thousand for FY2024 (same line in the FY2025 earnings release cash-flow statement); Q2 2026 Form 10-Q cash-flow statement shows the same line at $15,007 thousand for H1 2026 and $13,092 thousand for H1 2025. EDGAR companyfacts carries this expense under AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue ($20,595,000 FY2025 / $19,978,000 FY2024 / $13,739,000 FY2023), a tag the engine does not read; the engine's own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) have no values after 2011.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 (in fact all years 2012-2025 under the engine's tags). The filer's own reported FY2025 non-cash share-based compensation expense fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period, which leaves the 3-yr median base essentially unchanged (the median year is FY2025 itself under either the single value or the true per-year series $13,739k/$19,978k/$20,595k) and ttm.py prorates the same value across its legs, leaving TTM SBC at the FY2025 figure vs a true filed-leg TTM of $22,510k — a ~$0.04/share difference, immaterial to the verdict.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.4%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26, accession 0000105634-26-000025), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: 'Non-cash share-based compensation expense' $20,595 thousand for FY2025 and $19,978 thousand for FY2024 (same line in the FY2025 earnings release cash-flow statement); Q2 2026 Form 10-Q cash-flow statement shows the same line at $15,007 thousand for H1 2026 and $13,092 thousand for H1 2025. EDGAR companyfacts carries this expense under AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue ($20,595,000 FY2025 / $19,978,000 FY2024 / $13,739,000 FY2023), a tag the engine does not read; the engine's own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) have no values after 2011.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.4x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
